notes: Migrate hardware: move a working code base to another board. The source is pinned, the target is typed or scanned; a preliminary check lists every peripheral by priority (the AI accelerator first), what the target has, the best combination and the trade-offs, and the model it needs (free open-source models offered for approval); an ML use case gets its own chat with the target's official example; each peripheral is cloned, merged into one base and built, and ticked; the migrated code base opens in its own chat. Also: the build is checked against the vendor's own project.
